$comment: Committed, secret-free OpenCode MCP base config for the MrMap stack. Version-pinned to backend/.requirements/base.txt + frontend/package-lock.json. Host-specific/secret overrides belong in .opencode/opencode.json (git-ignored), generated by scripts/mcp-setup.sh. See docs/development/mcp-servers.md.

orm-lens.$comment: Static ORM analysis (pip: orm-lens[mcp]==1.18.0 into ~/.venvs/orm-lens, see scripts/mcp-setup.sh). Resolves the Django project from the session cwd, so worktrees analyze their own tree.

playwright.$comment: Needs Node >= 18 and a Playwright chromium (~/.cache/ms-playwright, refresh via: npx -y playwright install chromium).

postgres.$comment: DEV DB ONLY. Kept disabled here; scripts/mcp-setup.sh writes a local .opencode/opencode.json override that replaces this entry with the read-only DSN (role mcp_readonly via 127.0.0.1:15432 forwarder). Never add credentials to this file.

sonarqube.$comment: Official SonarQube Cloud-hosted MCP (EU/global). Read-only OAuth scope; per-user authentication via `opencode mcp auth sonarqube` stored outside Git. US-region installations must use https://api.sonarqube.us/mcp.
